_comment: Bible des personnages. Une description visuelle ecrite UNE fois, que
chaque prompt d'image reprend mot pour mot des qu'un alias apparait dans
la page. C'est la constance du TEXTE qui fait la constance de l'image :
ne pas reformuler une fiche sans regenerer les images concernees.
Les couleurs ne nomment que la palette HGR de l'Apple II -- noir, blanc,
violet, vert, bleu, orange. Dire 'gris' produisait du bleu a la
conversion, de facon coherente mais pas voulue.
`source` : `livre` = tire du texte original, `portage` = choix assume.

characters.look: THE HERO, the young paladin (in every image, always identical): a lean human adventurer in a hooded GREEN cloak over white chainmail, a round wooden shield on the left arm, a straight white sword, an ORANGE leather backpack, seen three-quarters from behind so the face stays hidden.

GROGNARD, a paladin in disguise: at first glance a rough, plain, heavy-set traveller in worn ORANGE-brown clothes; look closely and a WHITE cross is embroidered on his tunic and a plain WHITE sword hangs at his side. He stands taller than his clothes suggest.
STRATAGUS, the evil sorcerer: tall and skeletally gaunt, wrapped in a BLACK toga embroidered with VIOLET motifs that seem to writhe; hollow face, long thin hands, no weapon.
GAYOLARD, the good wizard: a stooped old man, long WHITE beard, plain BLUE robe, knotted wooden staff, kindly and unarmed.
POMPATARTE, the merchant: heavy-set and prosperous, ORANGE tunic over a round belly, rings on his fingers, a sly smile.
THE GARDEN MASTER: a lean man in long GREEN robes, bare-headed, a flower-shaped amulet on a chain at his neck, earth on his hands.
THE WOLF MASTER: a burly man wrapped in shaggy WHITE-and-BLACK wolf pelts, iron-hard face, short beard, a wolf-head amulet at his neck, heavy bare fists, no sword.
THE MISTRESS OF BIRDS: a beautiful woman seated on a stone pedestal in a WHITE gown, long dark hair, a SILVER bird-shaped amulet at her throat; eagles and herons walk freely around her.
THE SPIDER MASTER: a gaunt figure in tattered BLACK robes, a spider-shaped amulet at his neck, holding a slim glinting wand whose tip is smeared GREEN with poison.
THE FROG MASTER, a toad of a man: squat and wide-mouthed, damp GREEN-mottled skin, bulging eyes set high on the head, webbed fingers, a frog-shaped amulet at his neck, robes the colour of pond water.
THE PARROT: a large talking parrot with ORANGE, GREEN and BLUE plumage, perched and watching with one round eye.
